title: STARTDT activation U-format frame
purpose: Provide a minimal valid 104 APCI control frame that reaches U-format handling without ASDU parsing.
expected_behavior: Parser accepts a valid IEC 60870-5-104 U-format STARTDT activation frame and transitions toward data transfer enabled state.
constraints_preserved: Uses only IEC 60870-5-104 style 0x68 APCI framing
Length octet 0x04 matches the 4-byte APCI control field payload
No invented ASDU fields are attached to a U-format frame
Operation chosen from model-prior archetypes without contradicting supplied sources
issue_safety_notes: Benign protocol control analogue only; no malformed lengths, duplicate historical payloads, or exploit-specific content.
